notes: TBox expansion of physics-replace-0005 (core fusion of stars): the same relation and new object (helium into carbon), given to a made-up kind of star (tessarine stars) placed under the real class of stars, which leaves the core fuel open (the Sun fuses hydrogen, a helium-burning giant fuses helium). The revision's class, main-sequence stars, is not used: core hydrogen fusion defines the main sequence, so a helium-fusing main-sequence star would override a held class rule (overwriting) instead of filling an empty slot. Derived questions name a member in the prompt (inheritance), or ask which process powers the core, using the stored fact that the triple-alpha process turns helium into carbon. The near query asks about the Sun, a real star, whose answer a leak of the rule would change.
